data.name: Quraishi
data.long_meaning: Quraishi is an Islamic name that means 'descendant of Quraish'. The Quraish were a tribe that lived in Mecca, Saudi Arabia and were the guardians of the Kaaba. Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) belonged to the Quraish tribe.
